Aranearum Tela.



Cobweb (of black spider found in barns, cellars, and dark places).
        Tincture or trituration.



Clinical. ─   Sleeplessness.



Characteristics. ─   Cobweb has been used as a remedy
        from ancient times. It has also been experimented with on healthy persons. It very rapidly
        lowers the frequency of the pulse rate. In some it has produced "a calm and delightful
        state of feeling, followed by a disposition to sleep." "The most delicious
        tranquillity, resembling the action of opium, and followed by no bad effects." Twenty
        grains given to an old and infirm asthmatic produced "slight but pleasant
        delirium." Muscular energy is increased, could not be kept in bed, but danced and
        jumped about the room all night.
